versions.content: If J1939Tp Rx RetrySupport is disabled, when a sequence error occurs during reception , the J1939Tp module shall abort the reception session - as specified in SWS_J1939Tp_ 00031 and - as specified in SWS_J1939Tp_ 00097 with connection abort reason FF 16 (SNA).
